other_conditions: The student and his/her parents must belong to the Brahmin community.
Parents of the student must reside in Andhra Pradesh.
The student must be a regular (full‑time) student of the course for the academic year 2018‑19.
The student must be the topper of the entire course (SSC/Intermediate/Graduation/Professional Education) for the academic year 2018‑19.
Topper of SSC, Intermediate or Graduation must have completed the course in Andhra Pradesh.
Topper of Professional Education Course may have completed the course anywhere in India, but the parents must reside in Andhra Pradesh.
The student must not have availed any amount under any other government scheme for the same purpose.
benefits_summary: Cash awards ranging from ₹7,500 for SSC toppers up to ₹20,000 for Professional Education Course toppers.
